deprecated_yaml_device_tracker.description:
The {integration_title} device tracker configured through YAML is deprecated and will be removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.5.

Remove the `snmp` device tracker from your `configuration.yaml`, remove the devices tracked by SNMP (matched by MAC address) from `known_devices.yaml`, and restart Home Assistant.

Then set up the SNMP integration from the UI and enable the device tracker entities you want to use. Their entity IDs can be changed to the ones you used before.
